name: Agent Native Slides
description: Agent-Native Slides is an open-source AI presentation builder from Builder.io, built on the Agent-Native framework - which means every app action (generating a deck from a prompt, editing slides, applying brand styles, reordering, sharing) is exposed as an MCP tool over streamable HTTP. Connect Claude to the endpoint and it can build and revise real, editable decks a human can then refine in the visual editor or in code - there's no dead end where the AI's 85%-right output has to be rebuilt elsewhere. Decks can follow a supplied design system, or Slides derives one automatically from a reference deck and sticks to it. A library of data connectors pipes real data straight into your slides - no import/export dance. Also includes logo/image search, presentation mode, and an ask-agent meta-tool that hands complex requests to the app's own agent loop. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, and free - decks live in your repo, not a vendor's cloud. Auth is standard MCP OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agent Native Slides to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agent Native Slides to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://slides.agent-native.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agent Native Slides MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agent Native Slides provides these MCP tools: add-slide, ask_app, ask_app_status, clone-context-slide, context-manifest-get, create-deck, get-deck, list_apps, open_app, set-resource-visibility, and tool-search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agent Native Slides?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agent Native Slides in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Agent Native Slides MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agent Native Slides requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agent Native Slides is developed by Builder.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
